profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python, TypeScript, React, SQL
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with hands-on experience building full-stack applications, containerized data pipelines, and automated test suites. Proficient in Python, TypeScript, React, and SQL, with a strong foundation in object-oriented programming (OOP), data structures, and relational database design.

My background bridges application development and software quality. At Stellar AI and DataAnnotation, I built automated test scripts and benchmarking environments using Docker and Python, auditing complex algorithmic workflows, debugging edge-case logic regressions, and standardizing validation schemas to maintain reliable codebases. In full-stack development, I build end-to-end applications using FastAPI, React, and PostgreSQL/SQLite, focusing on clean API design and fast query performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Benchmarked 25–30 complex programming evaluation tasks weekly (Python, TypeScript) by deploying Docker containers and virtual machines, validating AI-generated plans & code for correctness and security across large codebases.
- Converted real-world GitHub pull requests and repository issues into structured RLHF/SFT datasets, creating reproducible unit tests and ground-truth edge cases to train autonomous coding agents.
- Reduced overall dataset failure rates from 60% to 25% by architecting standardized code-review rubrics, automated syntax/linting acceptance criteria, and structured feedback loops for 40+ technical contributors.
- Streamlined human-in-the-loop (HITL) data pipelines by profiling LLM agentic tool-use versus rule-based analysis, boosting dataset throughput while preserving 99%+ code accuracy.
- Written comprehensive technical SOPs, grading rubrics, and debugging methodologies to standardize multi-step technical reasoning and agentic function-calling evaluations across engineering projects/teams.
- Audited and refactored AI-generated code snippets and architectural patterns, eliminating logical regressions, hallucinated API signatures, and performance bottlenecks.
positions.insights: AI Model Training, Code Optimization and +4 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered and tested 200+ prompts and evaluation benchmarks, enforcing LLM safety guardrails, structured JSON outputs, and policy compliance.
- Built automated evaluation pipelines for coding models, integrating unit-test execution suites to score syntax validity, algorithmic complexity, and edge-case handling based on strict guidelines.
- Authored modular system prompt templates and technical documentation in Python and Markdown, establishing ground-truth baselines and fallback logic for LLM workflows.
- Implemented automated data validation and drift-detection scripts, catching schema errors, outliers across iterative model training cycles.
- Validated complex, multi-modal LLM outputs through rigorous peer reviews of annotations to ensure high-fidelity model training data.
